full_judgment: 2. The facts relevant for disposal of the Rule as stated in the writ petition, are that when the Noakhali District Head Quarter was under threat of soil erosion, the then Government acquired 608.23 acres of land from various plots of various Khatians of Mouza 170 Mirwarishpur, 171 Nazirpur, 237 Alipur, 238 Chowmuhani, 239 Ganipur, and 241 Narottampur, Police Station-Begumgonj through Land Acquisition Case No. 3(1) of 1941-42 for shifting the District Head Quarter Noakhali therein. Subsequently, the then Government took a decision to shift the District Headquarter Noakhali to Maijdee. Accordingly, the original owners of the land were not evicted from the acquired land. Meanwhile, during State Acquisition operation the acquired land was recorded in the name of the Government in Khas Khatian No. 1. However, the Government took a decision to lease out the acquired land to the different persons who are in possession including the petitioners and accordingly the Government took salami from them. The petitioners paid salami pursuant to Settlement Case Nos. 48 of 2007-2008 in respect of Plot No. 152 for 0.0350 acres of land; 49 of 2007-2008 in respect of Plot No. 152 for 0.035 acres of land; 50 of 2007-2008 in respect of Plot No. 152 for 0.0350 acres of land; 51 of 2007-2008 in respect of Plot No. 152 for 0.0350 acres of land; 52 of 2007-2008 in respect of Plot No. 152 for 0.0350 acres of land; 53 of 2007-2008 in respect of Plot No. 151 for 0.0760 acres of land; 54 of 2007-2008 in respect of Plot No. 151 for 0.0767 acres of land; 55 of 2007-2008 in respect of Plot No. 152 for 0.0650 acres of land; 56 of 2007-2008 in respect of Plot Nos. 150 and 151 for 0.0766 acres of land; 57 of 2007-2008 in respect of Plot Nos. 140 and 150 for 0.150 acres of land. But after receiving the salami, in spite of repeated representations made by the petitioners, the Government has yet not executed and registered any deed of the lease in favour of the petitioners. Therefore, the petitioners having no other equally efficacious remedy filed the instant writ petition and obtained the Rule as stated above.
